label: Numerical grounding and choice-partition controls for the invariant source
paraphrase: Premise-free mathematical controls on the fixed chance-rival frame (ChanceRival is the first conjunct): for every positive p and q with p+q=1 some PMF on the two existing histories has full support and masses p (withholding) and q (giving); two full-support laws (1/8, 7/8 and 3/8, 5/8) share the strict ranking withholding-below-giving and the tied-optimal output set (every output has the same quality) but differ; two laws on Bool with the same withholding mass are equal; two laws on Bool each giving its two points equal mass are equal, and one such full-support law exists; on three points, two full-support laws with equal mass on points 0 and 1 (a two-element orbit) differ at point 2. In a STIT frame over the same histories, singleton choice cells let the giver see to the giving and see to the withholding, while with one indiscrete cell the giving occurs but is not seen to. Diagnostic only: it does not show that a fixed complete essence permits variable intrinsic propensities, that some necessary nature grounds a particular law, or that intention guarantees sufficient reason.
